text:
mike: Heads-up — CI red on runtime::small_window_test for commit a1b2c3. Green locally for me. Build link: https://ci.redwood/test/12345. Anyone with a sec to kick a rerun or help bisect?
ci-bot: Buildkite: build 12345 — job small_window_test failed on agent gpu-7 (exit code 1). Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/12345
tara: Pong. I can take a quick rerun. mike, can you paste the failing stderr/snippet?
mike: here is the tail of the failing log:
```
AssertionError: window ordering mismatch
expected: [chunk0, chunk1, chunk2]
actual:   [chunk0, chunk2, chunk1]
  at runtime/tests/small_window.rs:142
```
jen: That looks nondeterministic — did you pin TEST_SEED or reduce parallelism? If not, try a deterministic rerun first.
mike: I didn't pin the seed on that run. Suggested rerun command: `bk retry --job 12345 --env TEST_SEED=20260318 --env WORKERS=1`
ben: Also try with `RUST_LOG=debug` and capture the ordering to a file so we can diff between runs: `--env RUST_LOG=debug --env ORDER_DUMP=/tmp/order.log`
tara: Kicked a rerun with seed=20260318 + WORKERS=1 now. Starting build 12346.
ci-bot: Buildkite: rerun 12346 started (parent 12345).
tara: First rerun finished and still failing. Short log: `window=[a, c, b] but expected [a, b, c]` — looks like a race in the prefetch/timer path.
mike: Ugh. Does anyone want to do a quick bisect? I suspect the prefetch timing change in a1b2c3.
jen: I can take a bisect tomorrow morning unless someone else picks it up now. Bisect plan: narrow to PR range, run with seed and workers=1, stop when reproducer hits.
mike: For the short-term CI hygiene I'll open a tiny PR that tags the test as flaky/small_window::ignore and add a reference. Willn't fix root cause but protects the tree.
tara: Please add a TODO and link to this thread + the failing seed in the PR description. Also create an issue with reproducer + artifacts.
mike: Created issue #789: https://issues.redwood/789 — includes log snippet, seed=20260318, and link to builds 12345/12346.
ben: For follow-up, can we add a nightly smoke that replays the small_window sequence with that seed so we get earlier detection?
jen: Agreed — put the reproducer into tests/smoke/replay_small_window.rs and run nightly.
mike: Thanks all. I'll land the flaky-ignore PR and start the bisect job tomorrow if nobody else does.
tara: Thanks — ping me if you want me to continue the bisect. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Note: job artifacts for builds 12345/12346 retained for 7d.
ben: Quick note — when bisecting, also try toggling the prefetch back to previous timing (cfg flag) to confirm causality.
mike: Good call. Adding that to the bisect checklist in issue #789.
tara: Ok wrapping up here, leaving the rerun artifacts in the issue.
jen: Thanks — keeping this thread as the primary coordination hub.
